📝 Mayor's Blog Update (Published: September 28, 2026)

On Monday, September 28, the organizers of "Yosakoï Hanno Ranbu" (a dance festival held on Saturday, September 19, 2026) visited to report on their Kumamoto earthquake relief charity event.

On behalf of Hanno City, I offer my deep respect and gratitude to everyone who took swift action to support the recovery of the affected areas. I am confident that your support and warm hearts will surely become a source of strength and vitality for the people in the disaster-stricken regions.
